title: ReconciledProfile
description: The complete structured output of one reconciliation run: atomic claims with citations, grouped by the underlying question they answer, each group marked agreed or disputed.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this contract the document was produced against. Bump on any breaking schema change.

generatedAt.description: When this profile was produced, RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 date-time.

model.description: Model id that produced this profile. Omitted for hand-written documents such as the example.

sources.description: Manifest of every source document that was supplied as input. A citation may only reference an id listed here.

claims.description: Flat list of atomic claims extracted from the sources. Grouping lives in `groups`, not here.

groups.description: Claims grouped by the underlying question they answer, with an agreement status per group.

id.description: Lowercase identifier, unique within its own collection.

entity.description: The single (fictional) entity this profile is about.

aliases.description: Other names the sources use for the same entity. Useful for the poisoned-input test case.

sourceRef.description: One entry in the source manifest. Mirrors the identifying fields of a SourceDocument fixture.

citation.description: One supporting source for a claim, together with the verbatim span from that source that supports it.

sourceId.description: Must match the `id` of an entry in the profile's `sources` manifest.

quote.description: Verbatim span copied from that source's `text`. The deterministic validator checks this is an exact substring — no paraphrasing, no ellipses, no normalisation.

claim.description: One atomic, self-contained factual assertion about the entity.

text.description: The claim as a single self-contained sentence, readable without the surrounding group.

citations.description: At least one citation. A claim supported by several sources carries one citation per source, so a claim can have more than one supporting source id.

group.description: A set of claims that answer the same underlying question, plus whether the sources agree on the answer.

question.description: The underlying question the member claims all answer, phrased as a question.

status.description: `agreed` when the member claims are mutually consistent; `disputed` when at least two member claims give conflicting answers to the question.

claimIds.description: Ids of the member claims, referencing the profile's `claims` array.

allOf.description: A disputed group must hold at least two claims side by side — the conflicting answers are never merged or resolved.
